Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the fundamental concept of the problem. It incorrectly reasoned that mass would change due to a very slight change in gravity at the top of a mountain. Mass, by definition, is an intrinsic property of matter and does not change regardless of gravity. The hypothetical reduction in gravity directly impacts **weight**, which is calculated as \( \text{mass} \times \text{gravity} \). The Planner failed to recognize this direct relationship and instead considered mass, leading to a wrong conclusion and prematurely marking the task as complete ("TASK_COMPLETE"). This error aligns with the "Misinterpretation of fundamental principles" and "Premature task completion" patterns discussed in the examples.
